Layers.EnterHint.zh: 双击文字重命名；双击图标或留白进入组合
Layers.EnterHint.en: Double-click text to rename; double-click the icon or blank space to enter

Layers.InstanceHint.zh: 双击文字重命名此实例；双击图标或留白编辑共享定义
Layers.InstanceHint.en: Double-click text to rename this instance; double-click the icon or blank space to edit its shared definition

Layers.LegacyOrder.zh: 保留旧图层顺序：成员可能与组外图层交错
Layers.LegacyOrder.en: Preserved legacy order: members may interleave with layers outside this group

Layers.CollectHint.zh: 收拢会将成员移至连续层级，可能改变与其他图层的遮挡关系。
Layers.CollectHint.en: Consolidating puts members in one consecutive block and may change overlaps with other layers.

Layers.TreeHelp.zh: 列表只展示当前层级的图层。双击文字优先重命名，包括组合；双击图标或文字外的留白、点击右侧箭头或按 Enter 进入组合。用上方面包屑切换层级，上一级按钮、左方向键、Backspace 或 Esc 返回一层。拖动手柄到行间可排序，拖到组合名称中间可移入，也可拖到面包屑移出。F2 也可重命名；Ctrl+G 编组，Ctrl+Shift+G 解组。旧跨层组合保留原画面，可从右键菜单明确收拢。
Layers.TreeHelp.en: The list shows only the current level. Double-click painted text to rename any layer or group. Double-click its icon or blank space, click its entry arrow or press Enter to enter a group. Use breadcrumbs to change levels; the parent button, Left, Backspace or Esc returns one level. Drag between rows to reorder, onto a group to move inside, or onto a breadcrumb to move out. F2 also renames; Ctrl+G groups and Ctrl+Shift+G ungroups. Legacy interleaved groups preserve their picture until explicitly consolidated.
